result.name: QFORM-PAIR-SCHUR-NUMERATOR-2VOLUME-v1
result.statement: For a literal physical pair H with polynomial Schur numerator N_H=det(B)D-C adj(B)C^T and disjoint residual banks I,J, if Z_N=e2(N_H[I,J]N_H[I,J]^T)>0 then the full ambient density satisfies ||p_Q||_inf <=8*2^(1/4)(1+pi) Z_N^(-1/12). Singular physical pairs are included by coefficient perturbation and weak interval domination.
result.regularity: essentially bounded density; continuity not proved by this receiver
result.mechanism: physical-pair one-third density envelope + sharp row-marginal-free two-volume half-Riesz on the exact Schur residual + Lyapunov exponent 2/3; det(B) cancels exactly before inversion
